sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term; the 2024 report's Moderator is David Grant, but the office is annual and its 2025 and 2026 outcomes are published nowhere official); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Strafford, 2024 Town Report, 'Town Officers' table (officers with term-expiry columns): 'Town Clerk and Treasurer: Lisa Bragg', on the combined term running to March 2027, which spans the March 2026 meeting
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lisa Bragg as Strafford's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Strafford, 2024 Town Report, 'Town Officers' table (officers with term-expiry columns): 'Town Clerk and Treasurer: Lisa Bragg', on the combined term running to March 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lisa Bragg as Strafford's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Jason Schumacher (Chair), Christopher Behr, Matthew Christie, Mary Linehan, and Marya Merriam; the 2024 report's board (Pippy, Linehan, Duncklee, Harman, Solsaa) turned over almost entirely across the 2025 and 2026 cycles, and the June 2026 directory governs the current five

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms; the 2024 report's roster (Jacobs, Denny, Gortner) predates two election cycles and its expiry column cannot be paired to names from the report's layout, and no current official roster exists); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated; the 2024 report's roster (Pennington, Liepmann, June Solsaa) is stale on the same terms as the listers above); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect trustees of public funds (three); the 2024 report's roster (Therese Linehan, Cindy Stableford, Sarah North) predates two election cycles); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Strafford, 2024 Town Report, 'Town Officers' table (officers with term-expiry columns): the table names five Cemetery Commissioners (David Harris, Andrew Behrens, Lauri Berkenkamp, Kate Siepmann, Sherm Wilson), which fixes the board at five seats under 18 V.S.A. sec. 5373, but the roster predates two election cycles and no seat's current holder is published, so the post is created without memberships (straggler)
